description: PuriPuly context ablation on the frozen v1 development dataset: A/B/C/D/O conditions across fixed models (gemma4-31b, gemma4-e4b-qat-q4). A/B use the neutral context prompt; C/D/O use the canonical PuriPuly policy prompt. D runtime selection is manifest-backed; O uses authoring-only relevantContextIndices.
